map.按中英文与代码估算 token 用量。: Estimate token usage by the mix of Chinese, English and code.
map.混合内容按三类分别折算：中文按字符、英文按词、代码按字符（切分最碎）。这是粗略预: Mixed content is converted by three classes: Chinese by character, English by word, code by character (split finest). This is a rough budgeting tool; actual values fluctuate +/-20% with tokenizer and symbol density, so leave a safety margin when judging whether you are near the context limit.
map.不同分词器差异较大，仅供参考。: Tokenizers differ greatly; for reference only.
map.按中英文与代码比例估算文本 token 数，提示不同分词器差异。: Estimate text token counts by the ratio of Chinese, English and code, and note the differences across tokenizers.
map.中文约 1~2 字/token(因模型而异)，英文约 4 字符/token，代码: Chinese is about 1-2 chars/token (model-dependent), English about 4 chars/token, and code is denser.
map.估算用于把控上下文窗口与 API 成本，精确值需对应模型分词器计数。: The estimate helps manage the context window and API cost; the exact value needs the corresponding model tokenizer count.
map.为什么中文 token 数不固定？: Why is the Chinese token count not fixed?
map.不同模型对中文的子词切分不同(按字/按词/混合)，同一段中文 token 数可差: Different models subword-split Chinese differently (by char / by word / mixed), so the same Chinese passage can differ several times in token count; this estimate only gives magnitude, and exact counts need the corresponding tokenizer.
map.代码为什么更费 token？: Why does code consume more tokens?
map.代码含大量符号、缩进与标识符，信息密度高、子词切分更碎，同等字符数常比自然语言消: Code contains many symbols, indentation and identifiers, with high information density and finer subword splits, so the same character count often consumes more tokens than natural language.
map.tokens ≈ 中文字数 / 1.5 + 英文词数 × 1.25 + 代码 t: tokens ~ Chinese chars / 1.5 + English words x 1.25 + code tokens
map.Token 估算（统一「每 token 字符数」口径）：tokens=中文字数÷: Token estimate (unified chars-per-token basis): tokens = Chinese chars / 1.5 + English words x 1.25 + code tokens (Chinese ~1.5 chars/token; English ~4 chars/token, about 5 chars/word = 1.25 tokens/word; code counted as entered). Validation: no hard checks; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed tiers; mixed text sums all three parts.
map.混合内容按三类分别折算：中文按字符（1.5 字符/token）、英文按词（约 1: Mixed content is converted in three classes: Chinese by character (1.5 chars/token), English by word (about 1.25 tokens/word), and code by its counted token total. This matches the Token Count Estimator page; see LLM Token Cost Estimator for pricing. It is a rough budget tool; actual values vary by tokenizer and symbol density by about ±20%, so leave headroom near the context limit.
map.口径判读（与上式互补）：中文≈字数÷1.5（1.5 字符/token）、英文≈词: Reading the convention: Chinese ~ chars/1.5 (1.5 chars/token), English ~ words x 1.25 (about 4 chars/token, 5 chars/word) are empirical BPE rates; enter code as its actual token count; the estimate is rounded. Validation: same as above; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed tiers; token, token-usage and token-2 share this basis.
map.一段 500 中文字+200 英文词：中文≈500÷1.5=333 token，: 500 Chinese chars + 200 English words: Chinese ~ 500/1.5 = 333 tokens, English ~ 200 x 1.25 = 250 tokens, total ~583; code tokens are added as entered. Actual counts vary by tokenizer.
map.中文约 1~2 字/token(因模型而异)，英文约 4 字符/token（约: Chinese is about 1-2 chars per token depending on the model, English about 4 chars per token (about 1.25 tokens per word), and code is denser.
map.一段 500 中文字+200 英文词：中文≈500÷1.5=333 token，: A sample of 500 Chinese characters + 200 English words: Chinese ≈ 500 ÷ 1.5 = 333 tokens, English ≈ 200 ÷ 0.75 = 267 tokens, about 600 tokens in total; code portions are added directly from already counted tokens. Actual counts vary with the model tokenizer.
